---
title: code-line-fragment-indices warnings
format:
  revealjs: default
  html: default
_quarto:
  tests:
    revealjs:
      printsMessage:
        - level: INFO
          regex: 'WARNING.*code-line-fragment-indices="1,2" needs a stepped code-line-numbers'
          count: 1
        - level: INFO
          regex: 'WARNING.*Ignoring code-line-fragment-indices="1,abc"; expected 2 non-negative integers'
          count: 1
        - level: INFO
          regex: 'WARNING.*Ignoring code-line-fragment-indices="1"; expected 2 non-negative integers'
          count: 1
        - level: INFO
          regex: 'WARNING.*code-line-fragment-indices="1, 2"'
          count: 0
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          - 'div[data-code-line-numbers="|1|2"][data-code-line-fragment-indices="1, 2"]'
        -
          - 'div[data-code-line-numbers="1,2"][data-code-line-fragment-indices]'
          - 'div[data-code-line-fragment-indices="1,abc"]'
          - 'div[data-code-line-fragment-indices="1"]'
    html:
      printsMessage:
        level: INFO
        regex: 'WARNING.*code-line-fragment-indices'
        count: 0
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - []
        -
          - '[data-code-line-fragment-indices]'
---

## Not stepped

```{.r code-line-numbers="1,2" code-line-fragment-indices="1,2"}
x <- 1
y <- 2
```

## Invalid entry

```{.r code-line-numbers="|1|2" code-line-fragment-indices="1,abc"}
x <- 1
y <- 2
```

## Wrong count

```{.r code-line-numbers="|1|2" code-line-fragment-indices="1"}
x <- 1
y <- 2
```

## Valid with whitespace

```{.r code-line-numbers="|1|2" code-line-fragment-indices="1, 2"}
x <- 1
y <- 2
```
